title: 从实体产品到月入1万美元的App：一个瑜伽品牌的进化论
title_en: From Physical Products to $10K/Month App: A Yoga Brand Evolution
title_jp: 物理製品から月収1万ドルのアプリへ：ヨガブランドの進化
title_ar: من منتجات مادية إلى تطبيق 10 آلاف دولار شهريا: تطور علامة يوغا

{"ops": [{"insert": "从实体产品到月入1万美元的App：一个瑜伽品牌的进化论"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 1}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": {"image": "https://storage.googleapis.com/indie-hackers.appspot.com/post-images/JLVZDxJ9RfjdYdvINqgp/vOqaQ3DJwYRP8MNEjUOSMger71w1/umberto-mezzadra-founder-of-floga.png"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你有没有试过——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "从"放下手机，专心练瑜伽"，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "变成"来，下载我们的App"？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这听起来很矛盾，甚至是背叛。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但Umberto Mezzadra做了这个转变。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "而且做得还不错——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "预launch 24小时收入12万美元。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在月入约1万美元。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "怎么做到的？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【从经济学到滑雪教练】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Umberto不是开发者。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他学的是经济学。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "在大公司 short stint，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "然后完全离开科技行业——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "成为滑雪教练，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "然后成为时尚摄影师。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2016年左右回来，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这次做 advertiser 和 growth strategist，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "帮公司 scale。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "在那里他真正学会了——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "怎么 launch、position、sell。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【COVID期间的转型】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2020年，疫情期间，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他和女朋友 starting PlayPauseBe——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一个围绕卡牌 deck 的品牌，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "帮瑜伽修行者 mindful 地建和练习自己的序列。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "整个理念是——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "放下屏幕，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "用心练习。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "第一款 deck 上Kickstarter，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "第一个月收入超过20万美元。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "然后——plot twist。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "大约一年半前，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他开始觉得 built 的东西可以变得更大。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "如果把这些 physical tools 用技术 push further——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不丢失 mindful core 呢？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "从"放下手机练习"到"这是我们的App"是矛盾，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他得 carefully work through。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一个晚上，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他坐下来，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " sketch 了 concept，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "在Lisbon找了个 great developer，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Floga就这样开始了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【Builder's Pull】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "什么驱动Umberto？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""建真正让人 feel better、"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " improve their lives 的产品。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这听起来简单，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但这是贯穿一切的 thread。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "PlayPauseBe的使命是——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " mindful、screen-free 练习。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "给瑜伽修行者一个工具帮他们慢下来、 reconnect，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不是又一个尖叫着要他们 attention 的App。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "看到人们每天在练习中用 decks，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "听到怎么改变了他们和瑜伽的关系，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " incredibly motivating。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "那个 feedback loop 是 best way 让人上瘾。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Floga来自想把同样 intention push further。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Builder's pull 也 motivates 他。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他喜欢 launch 的 craft——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " positioning 它，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " telling the story，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " watching it land with real people。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "多年为别人做 growth 之后，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他想把所有这些指向他自己 believe in 的产品——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "让人比他发现他们时好一点的产品。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "当你卖的东西 genuinely helps someone，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " marketing 就不 feel like marketing。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【建App前的验证】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "写任何代码之前，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "先 focus 在 validation。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他和 target market 的很多人聊要解决的问题，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但 never told 他们他在建App，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " never led them toward answer。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们想要 honest、unbiased reactions，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " not politeness。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "用 PlayPauseBe 的一些客户做的，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "收到 incredible feedback，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " exactly because they didn't know what he was fishing for。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一旦想法证明 viable，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们问——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""什么 minimum development stage 能让App传达 enough value——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " present 和 future——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "让 early adopters 愿意付费？""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不是 finished product。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Just enough 展示 real value 和 clear future direction。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "对他们来说，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "意味着 solid core，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "two well-built yoga styles，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "和人们能 believe in 的 roadmap。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他的 philosophy 是——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "同时建产品和 revenue engine，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "尽可能早 monetize。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "所以建的时候就在 planning 整个 launch machine，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "围绕 build timeline。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【非技术创始人的挑战】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "建App过程中有很多挑战。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最难的部分——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他对 mobile apps 零经验。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不是开发者，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "所以学怎么 scope、prioritize、"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " manage build，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "同时做关于它的决策。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最大的 trap 是——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不知道"good enough"长什么样——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "什么时候 keep polishing，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "什么时候 ship。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "作为 non-technical founder，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你得 get comfortable trusting your developer，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "同时 still push on things that matter to users。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "第二个挑战——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们整个品牌都建在 screen-free、mindful 练习上——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " typical 的App相反，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " engineered 抓 attention 和 keep users scrolling。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "所以他们有 tension——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "怎么为因为告诉他们放下手机而爱上他们的人建App？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不能 just copy 标准的 maximize time-on-screen 和 notifications playbook。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "App 得 support the practice 然后 get out of the way。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这让 build 复杂，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "因为 stay true to purpose 意味着App不能只是 functional——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "得 aesthetically stunning，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " evoke sense of mindfulness the moment you open it。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "每个 screen 都得 feel calm、intentional、beautiful。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "比"does it work"高得多的 bar，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " shaped countless design decisions。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他认为他们 pulled it off——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Floga是目前最美的 yoga app。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "第三个是——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " scope MVP 而不 gut the vision。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们得决定 minimum 是多少但仍然传达 real value 和 clear sense of direction——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " enough to get early adopters to pay——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "同时 resist urge cram everything in。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Cut features you're excited about 比听起来难，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但如果不做，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " never launch。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【技术栈选择】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们的栈和选择原因："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Flutter for the app：", "attributes": {"bold": true, "list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "开源，一套代码同时做iOS和Android，对小团队 huge deal——", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "  不用把 everything build 和 maintain 两次。也提供 polished、custom look 他们想要的，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "  given focus on design。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Firebase for the backend：", "attributes": {"bold": true, "list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "每月约25美元 at their stage，handle 很多 features out of the box——", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "  auth、database、hosting——所以不需要 set up own infrastructure。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "  对 early-stage app，cost 和 speed 很难 beat。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "RevenueCat for monetization：", "attributes": {"bold": true, "list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "Essential。Handle 他们的终身 deal，", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "  现在管理 cross-platform subscriptions，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "  不用自己 wrestle in-app purchase plumbing。也从里面拉 revenue analytics。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Vimeo host 所有视频内容：", "attributes": {"bold": true, "list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "Clean playback、no ads、reliable。", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "OneSignal for push notifications。", "attributes": {"bold": true, "list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【两阶段商业模式】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "商业模式分两个阶段 evolve。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Launch 时做了终身 deal 而不是 subscription，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "因为App还没完全建好，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "觉得让人们对还在 progress 的东西按月付费 wrong。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "完全在 App stores 之外 run，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " keep full revenue，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " no platform commission。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "那个 launch 24小时产生12万美元，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "提供 capital 和 committed early users 继续建。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "从那里，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "基于 early adopter feedback 继续 develop product，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " progressing further 后 introduce subscriptions。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "从那以后，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " focus 在 grow recurring revenue 而不是 one-off sales。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在有 healthy base 的 active paid 和 free users，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "正在 rework onboarding 和 conversion flow，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " better bring people into the app。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【内容机器】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "增长方面，两个渠道一起 work。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他最大的优势——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不是从零开始。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "通过 PlayPauseBe，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "已经建了 know 和 trust 他们的 audience。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "挑战是带他们 on the journey——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "解释为什么 screen-free 品牌要建App，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "为什么这是他们已经 love 的 next evolution，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " not contradiction。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "已经 believe in you 的 audience 是你 most valuable asset；"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " properly warming them up 比任何广告都 worth more。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "同时，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他 run lead generation reach 从没听过他们的人。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "完全不同的 approach——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这些人需要 education 和 trust before they buy。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "内容机器 tie both together。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "在 promote 任何东西之前，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "确保 content buffer ready——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " emails、videos、landing pages——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "设计来同时 educate 和 build trust。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Early adopters 也成了自己的 community；"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们的 word of mouth 和 feedback loop drove significant growth。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【把犹豫变成决定】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Launch 本身 presents big obstacle。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "人们 expect 免费试用——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "试一个月，不喜欢退款。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们要求人们为未完成的东西 upfront 付费。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "几周 warm people up、"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "完全 transparent 关于什么存在、什么 coming 之后，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他 drew clear line——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " no refunds，deal is the deal。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "如果有 doubts，可以等后面的 subscription——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但终身 offer 会 gone。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Combined with limited spots 和 tight window，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这 turned hesitation into decisions，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " largely contributed to launch's success。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "如果能重来，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他会更早 trust "ship before it's ready" instinct。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Perfectionism 往往只是 fear dressed up as preparation。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Real breakthroughs happened the moment"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们 put something unfinished in front of real people"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " and let their feedback guide them。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Uncomfortable，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但 far more valuable than polishing in isolation。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Move sooner，ship earlier，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " trust that you'll learn faster in public than you ever will in private。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【Move Sooner】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "给任何 starting out 的人几点建议："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Stop waiting for perfect。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Monetize as early as you can。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Don't wait until product is "done" to charge。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "建 audience 在你建产品之前。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "已经 trust you 的人是你 single most valuable asset。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "如果你能 launch to warmth instead of silence，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " everything gets easier。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Start sharing、teaching、building trust now，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "even before you have something to sell。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Don't underprice yourself。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "很多 founders price everything low out of fear nobody will buy。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Mistake——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " leave serious money on the table，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " signal low value。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Structure your pricing intentionally"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " instead of just throwing out lowest number you can stomach。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "诚实地和 real people 聊。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Ask about their problems"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " instead of pitching your solution。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Polite encouragement feels good，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但 tells you nothing。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Truth 是 what saves you from building the wrong thing。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Above all——move sooner，ship earlier，trust the process。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【The Apple of Yoga】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们 main goal 是 become biggest yoga app in the world。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "App 是更大的、tightly interconnected system 的一部分。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不只是 software company——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "是 brand，是 ecosystem。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "有 physical products。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "是 yoga school，提供 real education 和 training，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "certifying teachers。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "有 apparel、props、accessories。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "所有 standard 都一样——top quality，nothing compromised。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "App、physical tools、education、community——"}, {"insert": "

content_en: From Physical Products to $10K Monthly Revenue App: Evolution of a Yoga Brand. Have you tried going from 'put down phone, focus on yoga' to 'come, download our app'? Sounds contradictory even betraying. Umberto Mezzadra made this transition. And did quite well: $120K revenue in 24 hours pre-launch. Now makes about $10K monthly. How? Umberto is not a developer. He studied economics. Short stint at big company, then completely left tech industry to become ski instructor, then fashion photographer. Around 2016 returned, this time as advertiser and growth strategist, helping companies scale. That's where he really learned how to launch, position, sell. During COVID 2020, he and girlfriend started PlayPauseBe: a brand around card deck helping yoga practitioners mindfully build and practice their sequences. The whole philosophy: put down screen, practice with heart. First deck kicked on Kickstarter.
content_jp: フィジカル製品から月間1万ドルのAppへ：ヨガブランドの進化。「スマホ置いてヨガに集中」から「来て、Appダウンロード」に変えることを試したことがある？矛盾 甚至裏切りに聞こえる。Umberto Mezzadraはこの转变をした。そして結構良かった：プレlaunch 24時間で12万ドルの収益。今では月間約1万美元。怎么做到的？Umbertoは开发者ではない。经济学を学んだ。大企業でshort stint、その後完全に科技業界を離れて Ski instructor に、そしてファッション写真家に。2016年くらいに戻って、今回はadvertiserとgrowth strategist、公司をスケールさせるのを手伝う。ここで彼は本当に launch、position、sell を学んだ。COVID中の2020年、彼は彼女とPlayPauseBeを始めた：カードデッキを Rundaround、品牌帮助瑜伽修行者mindfulに构建和练习自己的序列。 Entire philosophy：画面放下、用心练习。最初のデッキはKickstarterでKickされた。
content_ar: من المنتجات المادية إلى تطبيق بقيمة 10 آلاف دولار شهريًا: تطور علامة يوغا. هل حاولت الانتقال من 'أضع الهاتف، ركز على اليوغا' إلى 'تعال، حمل تطبيقنا'؟ يبدو متناقضًا甚至 خيانة. Umberto Mezzadra جعل هذا الانتقال. And did quite well: 120 ألف دولار في 24 ساعة قبل الإطلاق. الآن يكسب حوالي 10 آلاف دولار شهريًا. كيف؟ Umberto ليس مطور. درس الاقتصاد. فترة قصيرة في شركة كبيرة، ثم ترك صناعة التكنولوجيا تمامًا وأصبح مدرب تزلج، ثم مصور أزياء. حوالي 2016 zurück، هذه المرة كمسوق وم strategist للنمو، يساعد الشركات على التوسع. هناك تعلم حقًا كيف يطلق ويضع ويبيع. خلال COVID 2020، هو وصديقته開始した PlayPauseBe: علامة حول مجموعة بطاقات مساعدة ممارسي اليوغا على الوعي ببناء وممارسة تسلسلهم. الفلسفة الكاملة: أضع الشاشة،مارس بالقلب. أول مجموعة kicks على Kickstarter.
